title: protocol: a refused field removal or type change names the views, forms and dashboard cards that still show the field
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this session's chat, 2026-11-18, verbatim: 「你要评估，云端哪些要迁移到开源项目，相关卡片要么关闭要么等待」, after 「开源项目能做的尽量在开源项目做，云端等开源项目完全优化好再开工」. Source of the inventory: a reading of the hosted tree at cloud main `0aabf9aa` against this repository's main `b1eb500d`, 2026-11-18. The open repository's agents cannot read the hosted tree, so what each item does is written here.

## Why

"This change loses data" is half of what the person confirming needs. The other half is what breaks on screen: the list that shows the column, the form that edits it, the card that sums it. The open write face names the lost data only.

Who acts: the server lane (`packages/metadata-protocol`). Reader: a person in Studio, and an AI client, deciding whether to confirm.

## Evidence

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-write-face.ts:230` reports `field_removed` and `field_type_change`. Nothing lists where the field is still shown.
- The hosted build door adds that list for its own tools, and has an open request to also name views whose filters stop fitting after a type change.

## Scope

- The `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` answer gains `stillShownBy`: the views, forms, dashboards and flows that reference the field, computed from the stored metadata. For a type change, also the view filters whose operator no longer fits the new type.
- One place judges which operator fits which field type, exported, so no door keeps its own table.

## Done when

- Removing a field shown by a list view and a form names both in the refusal, on REST and on the MCP draft door.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34766.
